title: CE21004: Structural Analysis
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Energy Method (Ritz) and Error Orthogonalization (Galerkin) for indeterminate
beams, curved beams, arches and rings; Matrix Force and Displacement Method for
Frames and Trusses- Analysis for temperature stress, lack of fit and settlement
of supports; Plastic analysis; Variational Approach – Introduction to Finite
element Method for frames, trusses and plane stress analysis; Geometric
Stiffness Matrix; Compound Structures; Suspension and guyed Bridges; Influence
lines.

Concepts taught in class

Bending moment of determinant and indeterminant structures.

Student Opinion

{|class="wikitable"

||The real calculations behind constructing a structure is taught here. The different kind of beam designs are taught. From this subject you will be able to know how beams and columns are designed with calculating the load. Take the course very seriously because it will be the fundamentals of designing a structure.

How to Crack the Paper

{|class="wikitable"

||Attend the classes seriously. Solve the tutorials by yourself. Get hold of a book by consulting the prof and practice the problems given in it. 

Classroom resources

Do the tutorials by yourself and solve additional problems from the books given by the prof. Raise any doubt you have because no doubt is silly.

Additional Resources

Consult your senior
